newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA 97/98 FOODGRAINS OUTPUT TARGET 200/202 MLNT.
newsitem.headline: INDIA 97/98 FOODGRAINS OUTPUT TARGET 200/202 MLNT.

text.p: India has set a foodgrains output target of 200-202 million tonnes for the 1997/98 (July-June) season, Agriculture Minister Chaturanan Mishra said on Friday.
India produced 198 million tonnes of foodgrains in the 1996/97 season.
Mishra told the upper house, or the Rajya Sabha, the estimated demand for foodgrains in the country is expected to be about 216.5 million tonnes by 2001/2.
Foodgrains production is expected to touch 223 million tonnes by 2001/2, Mishra said.
He said the agriculture sector is expected to grow at 4.5 percent annually during the ninth-five-year plan that began from April 1, 1997. -- New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 2024; Fax 91-11 301 4043
